DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Death Knight when:

  • They have the Obliteration talent and Pillar of Frost is active (or they don’t use Pillar of Frost at all).
  • They are using Breath of Sindragosa and its buff is already active during its duration.
  • They do not use Obliteration nor Breath of Sindragosa talents (e.g., other builds like Frostscythe).
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • The Demonhunter is transformed via Metamorphosis to maximize cooldown synergy during their burst window.
  • The encounter will end in 20 seconds or less to ensure the full duration is utilized before combat concludes.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • they activate Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune to maximize their burst window.
  • they use Convoke the Spirits during their primary damage phase.
  • they are in their primary burst window with stacked offensive cooldowns, trinkets, or potions active.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane is active (buff.bs_inc.up), aligning with their major DPS cooldown window.
  • They do not have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent selected, prioritizing cooldown synergy outside that build.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active and one of the following is true: Shattering Star is unavailable (on cooldown), the target has the Shattering Star vulnerability debuff, or there are 2+ enemies in combat.
  • The encounter will end in under 35 seconds (to avoid holding the cooldown).
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • Trueshot is active and will remain for more than 12 seconds to maximize its synergy with their burst window.
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds to ensure the full duration benefits from a final damage push.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active.
  • The Hunter is not using Coordinated Assault and Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • The Hunter is not using either Coordinated Assault or Spearhead in their build.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • The Mage is not wearing Spymaster’s Web and just cast Arcane Surge as their previous ability.
  • The Mage is wearing Spymaster’s Web and just cast Evocation as their previous ability.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Combustion is about to come off cooldown and aligns with their pre-cast preparation phase.
  • Combustion is already active and has more than 7 seconds remaining on its duration.
  • There are fewer than 20 seconds remaining in the encounter.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • The Mage does not already have the Power Infusion buff active.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • The Monk's Xuen the White Tiger is active and Bloodlust is not active.
  • The Monk's Xuen the White Tiger is active, Bloodlust is active, and Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • They activate Avenging Wrath, their primary offensive cooldown.
  • They activate Crusade (if using this talent instead of Avenging Wrath).
  • The target is affected by their Execution Sentence debuff (if they’ve chosen this talent).
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • The Rogue's Deathmark is active and dealing damage over time.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They activate Shadow Dance, as this is their primary damage window where they use high-impact stealth abilities.
  • Their burst rotation is fully engaged, ensuring maximum benefit from Power Infusion’s haste and damage amplification during this critical phase.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • Ascendance is currently active, maximizing damage during their primary cooldown window.
  • Ascendance has more than 30 seconds remaining on its cooldown, ensuring no unnecessary delay in using Power Infusion.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance is active, Feral Spirit wolves are summoned, or Doom Winds buff is active.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds and using Power Infusion won’t overcap cooldown timings.
  • All major offensive cooldowns are unavailable for 2 minutes or longer, making immediate Power Infusion optimal.
  • The Shaman does not have Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds talents, requiring neutral timing.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • They are actively using major offensive cooldowns during a burst window, such as alongside Summon Darkglare or stacked damage-over-time effects.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Their Imp Gang Boss despawn timer is active and expires within 2 global cooldowns + Demonic Tyrant cast time later.
  • They recently cast Hand of Gul'dan or Ruination, ensuring maximum imps are active.
  • Either:
    • Their imps will despawn before the next global cooldown + Demonic Tyrant cast time ends, or
    • They have fewer than 2 Soul Shards to summon new imps immediately.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Summon Infernal is active, ensuring alignment with their major damage window.
  • They do NOT have the Summon Infernal talent, as their cooldowns aren’t tied to Infernal timing.
  • The fight will end before their next Summon Infernal cooldown (+15 seconds), forcing an urgent use of Power Infusion.
  • The remaining fight time is shorter than their next Summon Infernal cooldown (+10 seconds) but longer than Power Infusion’s duration, ensuring its full effect.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Colossus Smash is active on the target and the encounter will last longer than 135 seconds.
  • The warrior enters Execute Phase (target ≤20% health) while Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds (final burn phase).
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining and the encounter will last at least 2 minutes and 15 seconds more.
  • The target is in Execute phase (below 20% health) while Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds, regardless of other cooldowns.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They're fighting ≥1 enemy during a single-target phase or when additional enemies are present AND meet any of:
  • Their Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining (prioritizing its burst window)
  • They use Army of the Dead (without Gargoyle) and either Abomination is active <18 seconds remaining or Army Ghouls have ≤18 seconds left
  • They lack both Gargoyle and Army of the Dead talents, and Dark Transformation is active
  • Dark Transformation is active while not using Gargoyle (even with Army of the Dead)
  • Gargoyle isn't active and its cooldown won't align with Power Infusion's duration
  • Fighting ≥3 enemies while Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is damaging enemies
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when Power Infusion is not active and one of these conditions is met:

  • The Priest is in Voidform.
  • The Priest has Dark Ascension active.
  • The Priest is wearing the The War Within Season 2 4-piece set.
